dedupe_keys.name: appliances energy prediction monitored low energy house

description: This dataset records appliance electricity use and indoor environmental conditions in one low-energy house in Belgium. Luis Candanedo and collaborators publish 19,735 observations with 28 input features and an appliance-energy target through UCI, with related R scripts and CSV files on GitHub. Coverage is about four and a half months at ten-minute intervals; the inspected metadata does not state the complete calendar interval. Variables include appliance and lighting energy in Wh, room temperatures and humidity, and weather from Chievres Airport. Indoor sensor transmissions were averaged into ten-minute periods, while airport observations include interpolated hourly values. UCI provides free public CSV access under CC BY 4.0. The original weather redistribution permission is described on the deposit. A limitation is that the observations represent one house, not a building-stock sample. Two deliberately random variables are included and should not be interpreted as physical drivers. Simulation uses include calibrating appliance-load models and testing building-demand forecasts. It relates to model-energyplus as a potential source of empirical demand inputs, without a verified direct import workflow. No observations were downloaded and no forecasting results were reproduced.
name: Appliances Energy Prediction: monitored low-energy house
